current_scope.centralized: One IdealInformation with one IdealTransport/ReceivedStore, one PeerObstacles for all three outputs, one MotionSafety with three logical per-robot guard calls; ideal broadcast copies are not three independently isolated robot network endpoints.
current_scope.current_order: At each physical paused20ms boundary: actual state publication/delivery -> actual peer consumption/publication -> actual motion dependencies/guard publication+local topic receipt -> exact native driver target storage -> physical20ticks.
current_scope.local_boundary: Guard i consumes own local raw odom/TF plus delivered peer state. Although the central node subscribes all local sensors, a peer promise must come from the common received table, never a direct other-robot tracker/intent dictionary.
current_scope.future_network_scope: No P3 byte transport/faulted fanout/cross-process isolation or three independently delayed receiver ACK claim.

design_decision: Complete typed native actuation receipt selected by parent; permanent X simplification is not selected.

recommended_steps.action: Freeze one received bundle and intent table for all three logical guards. In D/HOLD, a request to start translation creates immutable pending X with declared admitted_signs and old anchor; the actual issued target at T is v=0,w=0. Publish owner intent and return its exact refs in the motion ACK; this publication is not storage or actuation.

Existing worker waits the exact three real driver storage receipts for current outputs. Match epoch/robot/clock/decision sequence/native cmd sequence and actual zero; no advance if missing or overwritten. Keep old D/HOLD physical obligation and conservative X bridge; do not re-anchor.

Request exact refs from previous actual motion ACK (or explicit post-release bootstrap intents), never worker-invented intent bytes. Information independently receives source intents, waits for matching refs, and serializes the whole safety sidecar inside the immutable state envelope. Preserve odom/TF originals, existing measured source stamps and map streams. Carry separate intent evidence source/age; a historical anchor does not become a fresh source.

PeerObstacles must actually receive the matching entire state bundle plus raw odom/TF side publications. Validate all three typed sidecars, exact refs, table digest and unchanged .5s ages, then produce obstacle ACK bound to the whole bundle/table. Its cloud computation still uses existing received odom/TF; metadata does not create a new peer position.

MotionControlPhase requires its own actual subscriptions to the same state and peer ACKs, exact common bundle/table digest, and per-robot self-announcement matching the frozen table. All three guard calls read the same immutable table. Only then can a command within the preannounced signed family be nonzero; all corresponding geometric roles remain X (q=4R) until actual takeover is evidenced. A changed/reversed sign needs a new union/announcement or stopping, never hindsight sign fitting.

Native OnUpdate selects target under the existing command mutex, computes unchanged paired outputs, performs all actual wheel writes, and publishes a new typed actuation receipt before releasing the same phase. The receipt records actual consumed seven-field target, native cmd_seq, actuation_seq/time, dt, each pair index and actual current/desired/applied rim values, alpha and acceleration bound, plus payload/result identity.

recommended_steps.phase: later local source O strictly greater than A
recommended_steps.action: Guard admits only actually received/causally promoted native actuation receipts; waits a matching own raw odom with source O>A and O<=guard clock. Same-clock odom cannot qualify: current OnUpdate publishes odom before wheel actuation. Check fresh raw consistency/model bounds and the declared signed role. Storage ACK alone, later unrelated odom, an audit JSON row or receipt publication alone cannot narrow X to N.

Owner emits N intent with exact actuation/raw witnesses. All logical guards continue using X until the new N intent is actually delivered inside a new matching common state/peer bundle. Only then may they narrow to N(q=2R). Future re-anchor into a new D needs proven executed N lineage followed by genuine zero/rest qualification and a newly delivered anchor; a nonzero publication or unconsumed target cannot refresh the old D anchor.

bootstrap.required_new_condition: Explicit conditional initial HOLD terminal invariant: for each robot, while initial full zero HOLD persists, centre remains within radius R=.0078 of one immutable release anchor and full planar residual<=.01; all pair checks use that declared role and original body/margin/age gates. This is a plant assumption to falsify/validate, not a fact proved by stored zero or three samples.
bootstrap.release_anchor: Bind the actual release clock to the exact last successful controlled state/peer bundle and each corresponding already-allowed own raw odom payload. Own and received anchors use these fixed identical source identities; no SLAM-history remapping. Reject missing/mismatched raw anchor or calibration. Earlier source time may define the anchor if genuinely causal/fresh; it does not grant pre-release publication credit.
bootstrap.bootstrap_protocol: Owner emits explicit PRE_RELEASE no-credit intents and zeros for initial phase, then post-Header RELEASE_HOLD intents bound to actual release and release bundle. Worker waits those real source refs; Information independently receives them before the next commit. This prevents a source-callback race and does not add a policy action/feature or move task release.
bootstrap.qualification: .94 zero-publication qualification is clamped to release (existing release() behavior); all three qualifying raw samples must be later than release+.94, causal/fresh with original gap constraints. Before qualification only v=0,w=0; no angular settled exception. Original .78 stored-zero/160ms timing audit remains required.
bootstrap.not_proven: Initial disk invariance, continuing terminal rest and continuous-time residual/sweep are not implied by finite CPU traces. If no such explicit source/plant assumption is defensible, bootstrap admission is blocked; generic .144 stop cannot silently substitute because original close initial spacing may fail that larger reach.

calibration.fact: Existing WORLD producer samples model WorldPose/WorldLinearVel once, then float yaw and cosf/sinf convert to body XY. A=[[c,s],[-s,c]], q=c²+s²; q is generally not 1, so raw body norm<=.01 is not itself an exact WORLD residual certificate.
calibration.selected_minimal_direction: Same native odometry producer publishes typed supplemental actual c/s (and exact odom source/pose/payload identity and conversion contract). Information carries this inside the same safety sidecar; no new ModelStates subscription, no new actor fields and no extra WORLD velocity truth payload. Root CPU prototype calibration_metric_v1.py is mathematical only, not an implemented ROS conversion.
calibration.conditional_metric: For actual finite coefficients and IEEE64 RN, including FMA/non-FMA envelope: E=(2u+u²)*V*(|c|+|s|)+(3+2u)*eta, u=2^-53, eta=2^-1075, V=.3. Full residual bound compares (|b0|+E)^2+(|b1|+E)^2 <= limit^2*q. Signed wrong-forward bound and lateral bound use the same q; STOP/empty signs uses the full speed. Exact outward arithmetic, never a threshold epsilon.
calibration.double_only_limit: Changing yaw/c/s to double reduces error but does not make q exactly1 and is not sufficient proof. Such producer revision requires its own source/ELF binding and conversion-rounding qualification; the metric must use the coefficients actually used.
remaining_obligations: V=.3 and floating-point/underflow/rounding assumptions must be explicitly part of the source model, not proved by this metric or by old samples.
The normalized c/s axis must be calibrated against true physical heading/pose; a rigorous sector enclosure includes conversion angular error. An odom frame string alone does not prove this.

Current WORLD odometry was already the accepted local measurement representation. Adding coefficient metadata is an explicit new measurement-calibration payload/contract; do not claim bytes/information schema unchanged. Directly adding WorldLinearVel XY would enlarge payload and needs separate reviewed information contract; not selected here.

cpu_test_plan.cases: Mutate original dict after send; mutate decoded received copy; missing/extra safety keys, bool-as-int, NaN/Inf, wrong schema/robot/epoch, unknown role/signs. All malformed fail closed; immutable bytes stable.

Worker supplies plausible refs but Information never receives source intent; wrong packet GID/multiple owners; wrong topic/robot; queued source later than target. No state ACK/nonzero; do not manufacture envelope from RPC refs.

Each of state, peer, motion sees different intent bytes with same claimed id; changed table digest; shuffled guard iteration order; arrival of a newer bundle between phases. Require actual canonical equality and all three logged decisions use the same frozen table.

.5s accepted only for otherwise valid state/evidence; +1ns rejects. Future/reordered/duplicate-conflicting intent sources reject. Old anchor identity may remain old but renewal must carry real fresh evidence and must never rewrite anchor/source history.

Nonzero requested while D: first actual published/stored target is zero. No X delivery, only X publisher return, wrong state phase, stale peer ACK, one missing robot => no nonzero. Exact next true20ms complete state/peer X permits only the announced signed family.

A zero/nonzero target is stored then overwritten before wheel update. Storage never counts as actual takeover or anchor refresh. Later odom alone and audit-file presence do not repair missing online actuation receipt.

Wrong epoch/robot/native cmdseq/target clock/decisionseq/actuationseq/pair order/result hash; dropped pair or mismatched paired arrays; duplicate changed record. Strict parser rejects; unchanged duplicate idempotent only.

Actuation receipt source A may arrive before /clock A; retain pending until causal. Raw source=A rejects for N, raw source>A<=clock with exact target witness can advance owner state. Wall arrival ordering cannot override source ordering.

Owner N computed locally but envelope still X => every logical guard keeps X. Full delivered N permits narrowing only after actual lineage proof. Mode reversal requires predeclared old/new sign union or stop; actualvx sign cannot select a convenient sector after observation.

Repeated zero grants, zero pulses, nonzero publication not actuated, pending-X canceled, or a single changed scalar must not reset old anchor/qualification. Only actual executed handoff followed by complete new zero/rest/delivery lineage may create a new anchor.

Pre-release .94 history, stamps before release, repeated release, wrong release bundle/raw anchor, missing explicit initial HOLD terminal assumption, nonzero w before qualification, zero ACK mistaken for rest. Reject qualification/advance as appropriate. First valid grant requires full release-based .94 plus three later causal fresh samples and original storage audit.

Hold delivered peer records fixed and alter forbidden raw peer/SLAM/truth/oracle data: per-robot guard geometry must not change. Local own sensors still allowed. A source-identity mismatch or unavailable calibration denies; no fallback to live peer raw/ModelStates.

Vary only safety sidecar bytes; original observation JSON projection, all encoded tensors/dimensions, masks/candidates, goals, original maps and navigation-map payloads remain identical for identical original inputs. Real motion effects are allowed to alter later genuine observations, never falsified to force equality.

q!=1 counterexample, wrong-sign forward residual, STOP with residual=full planar speed, FMA/non-FMA rounding and subnormal bounds, c/s metadata from another odom/source/pose, missing actual coefficients. No epsilon, no new truth; body/publication match alone not a calibration proof.

Stop during each pending phase, timeout, missing receipt, actual model failure, terminal cancellation, changed saved identity. Preserve actual samples/errors and original forbidden-training behavior; no buffer/GAE/optimizer admission from an invalid round. No hidden extra reset/action/native retry.
